security_control_note: The same four new credential assertions fail against the R33 login handler in an isolated baseline copy and pass against the fixed handler. No production database or account was used.

checks: Real API returns 25 rows for the initial 1200-member directory
Next page retrieves a distinct server page
Persian prefix plus search reaches the last student, beyond the old display limits
Confirmed detach updates the filtered count and empty state
Adding the detached member refreshes the already expanded directory
Injected network failure hides stale actions; Retry recovers through real API
Mobile Persian filters and real member row render with bounded table
On the extracted live server, changing the real admin password rejects both historical defaults while the new credential works

limitations: Bounded responses do not imply unlimited scalability; OFFSET and substring searches still have costs.
Legacy teachers/students response arrays now contain only the current page.
Existing sessions are not globally revoked by deployment; changing a password uses the existing token-version invalidation.
No investigation of production access history or claim that past compromise did not occur.
